name: xView3-SAR: Global Maritime Illegal Fishing Detection Benchmark
description: The xView3-SAR dataset was created by the Defence Innovation Unit (DIU) and Global Fishing Watch to combat Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated (IUU) fishing through automated machine learning on synthetic aperture radar (SAR). It comprises 991 full-size analysis-ready Sentinel-1 SAR scenes (averaging 29,400 x 24,400 pixels) covering over 43 million km² of ocean surface, paired with bathymetry, wind speed, and sea state rasters. The dataset features 243,018 maritime object annotations correlated with Automatic Identification System (AIS) transponder broadcast data to detect vessels, estimate length, and identify dark targets operating with AIS disabled.
